traced_net.title: Shared 45 V screen lead (upstream source unresolved)
traced_net.description: The factory schematic shows a continuous conductor from the 7A8 screen-grid glyph to the 7B7 screen-grid glyph, with 45 V marked at both tube branches. Sylvania pin data maps those screen electrodes to V1:5 (7A8 G3/G5) and V2:3 (7B7 G2). This records only the shared tube-side conductor; it does not identify a regulator, dropping element, source impedance, or complete supply path.

verified_endpoints.interpretation: 7A8 screen grids G3/G5 map to socket pin 5; the p.38 screen glyph lead joins the same annotated 45 V conductor as the 7B7 screen branch.
7B7 screen grid G2 maps to socket pin 3; the p.38 screen glyph lead joins the same annotated 45 V conductor as the 7A8 screen branch.

limits: The “45 V” callout is transcribed as a schematic annotation; no meter reference, operating condition or tolerance is asserted by this trace.
The upstream feed to this shared screen conductor is not source-traced here.
This trace does not close the 7A8 oscillator, 7A8 cathode, 7B7 cathode, IF transformers or receiver behavior.
unresolved: Upstream source and any intervening impedance for the shared 45 V lead.
7A8 cathode/suppressor external connection and 7B7 cathode/suppressor connections.
Full receiver and full-receiver SPICE validation.

V1:5.scope: Manufacturer basing data maps screen grids G3/G5 to socket pin 5; it does not document PT-44 wiring.

V2:3.scope: Manufacturer basing data maps screen grid G2 to socket pin 3; it does not document PT-44 wiring.
